{{Quote|My anti-concepts were sublime in their nothingness.|Cold Danda Sine|<ref name="tilotny">{{StoryCite|story=Tilotny Throws a Shape|book=The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 154}}</ref>}}
'''Cold Danda Sine''' was one of the four [[Bedlam Spirits]], transdimensional beings that resided in the [[Bedlam Pulsar/Legends|Bedlam Pulsar]] and appeared to have completely omnipotent powers over time and matter. Cold Danda Sine was present for occasional experiments on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bedlam/Legends|Bedlam]], where the Spirits would play with the fabric of existence itself.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I despair for your tastelessness, Tilotny. Now none of them are moving. Throwing shapes is dull. It is not a new thing anymore. Let us go.|Cold Danda Sine|<ref name="tilotny" />}}
Along with [[Tilotny]], [[Horliss-Horliss]] and [[Splendid Ap]], Cold Danda Sine was one of the four [[Bedlam Spirits]], omnipotent and transdimensional beings with godlike powers over form, matter and time. The four were so named because they were known to occasionally alight upon the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bedlam/Legends|Bedlam]],<ref name="TEA" /> which provided a setting for the entities' experiments upon the fabric of reality. Cold Danda Sine was present when the Bedlam Spirits discovered [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] leader [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and a group of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] on Bedlam during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], watching as Tilotny and Horliss-Horliss [[Death/Legends|killed]] the organics by altering the compositions of their bodies in dramatic ways. Dismayed at their treatment of the "tiny movers," Cold Danda Sine urged them to leave, and Splendid Ap was assigned to restore them to their proper form.<ref name="tilotny" /> Some knowledge of Cold Danda Sine and its fellow Spirits' existence filtered out in the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] in the decades to come, as visitors to Bedlam discovered impossibly transmuted materials and objects thrown wildly through time.<ref name="TEA" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Oo-la! Solids... and things that are up and down! Did you make this place, incomparable Horliss-Horliss?|Cold Danda Sine|<ref name="tilotny" />}}
Appearing as a floating [[Color/Legends|black]] and orange sphere with a face, Cold Danda Sine was capable of manipulating [[Time/Legends|time]] and mass, as were the other four Bedlam Spirits. However, Cold Danda Sine and Splendid Ap were regarded as lesser powers by Tilotny&mdash;in turn, Cold Danda Sine scorned Tilotny and admired Horliss-Horliss, referring to him incomparable and inventive. Among his studies of the fabric of the universe, Cold Danda Sine was particularly proud of his "anti-concepts."<ref name="tilotny" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cold Danda Sine appeared in ''[[Tilotny Throws a Shape]]'', a short comic story written by [[Alan Moore]] and illustrated by [[John Stokes]], and originally appearing in ''[[The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 154]]'' in the United Kingdom.<ref name="tilotny" /> In ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', the name is misspelled as "Cold Danda Sire."<ref name="TEA" />
